summary: Comprehensive backend testing for SiKerja attendance system. Created pytest suite covering auth (admin/employee/cross-role), employees/departments/locations/holidays CRUD, attendance workflow (WFH success, WFO geofence rejection, duplicate check-in/out, checkout-before-checkin), holiday-block, leave approval blocking check-in, work-plans, weekly/monthly reports, Excel/PDF exports, settings persistence, and change-password. All 32 tests passed (100%). No backend issues detected.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] is invalid per browser CORS spec; when credentials are used, origins must be explicit. Currently harmless (frontend uses Bearer tokens, not cookies) but should be tightened.
Duplicate check-in error uses HTTPException 400 but if a prior (same-day) record exists without check_in_time it would be overwritten; edge case unlikely in practice.
Employee status ('inactive') check exists on login but no explicit status check on middleware for existing tokens — a deactivated employee retains a valid token until expiry.
server.py is ~930 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, attendance, reports, exports, settings) for maintainability.
clean_doc returns None-ish behavior when d is falsy; some callers assume dict — safe in current usage but fragile.
monthly_report uses datetime.fromisoformat on week_start param name mismatch — not a bug but week_start endpoint has no validation for malformed dates (would raise 500 instead of 400).
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on login endpoints (playbook mentions 5-attempt lockout requirement).
Password change endpoint accepts raw dict rather than Pydantic model — inconsistent with rest of API.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed employees/departments/holidays dynamically per run; not cleaned up but namespaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (32/32). Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~8s via pytest-xdist (2 workers). Fresh employees are minted per attendance test to avoid same-day collision. Office geofence seed: lat=-6.175392, lon=106.827153, radius=200m. Frontend testing not performed as request was backend-only.
